meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给访谈播客视频配上时间同步的图形卡片，让画面更生动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你有采访或播客视频,想加标题和重点提示又不重剪
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic cards to talking-head videos for a polished, lively look
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have interview or podcast footage and want to add graphics without re-editing

howto.what: 装上后,它会给已有访谈/播客视频配上与语音同步的图形卡片(标题、下三分之一、数据标注、引语、画中画等),原片不动,最后渲染成 MP4 文件。
howto.when: 当你说到 graphic overlays、on-screen graphics 等关键词,或要求给视频做图形包装时触发;纯字幕不触发。

say.text: 给这个访谈视频加上数据标注和动态标题。
say.note: 会生成与语音同步的卡片并渲染 MP4。

say.text: 把这个播客片段做成 9:16 竖版,叠加大号引语和画中画。
say.note: 按竖版画布排布卡片,输出竖屏视频。

say.text: 在视频下部加个下三分之一条,显示发言人的名字和头衔。
say.note: 卡片在对应讲话时间出现。

howto.what_en: Claude overlays timed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, PiP) on your existing talking-head video, synced to the speech, leaving the original clip untouched, and renders the composite to MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for graphic overlays, on-screen graphics, or to 'package/dress up' an existing video (e.g., interview/podcast clip); not for plain subtitles.

say_en.text: Add data callouts and animated titles to this interview video.
say_en.note: Claude builds timed cards from transcript and renders MP4.

say_en.text: Make this podcast clip 9:16 vertical with large quotes and picture-in-picture.
say_en.note: Lays out cards for a vertical canvas, outputs portrait video.

say_en.text: Put a lower-third under the video showing the speaker's name and title.
say_en.note: Cards appear in sync with the speech.
